ground_truth: A massive brick-lined basin interpreted by S.R. Rao as a tidal dockyard (debated)

Archaeological excavations revealed a complex system of canals, basins, and mooring platforms designed to accommodate ships and facilitate trade. This sophisticated infrastructure demonstrates a level of engineering and organizational skill rarely seen in contemporary settlements. (Kenoyer, 2006, p. 138; Sharma & Sharma, 2013, p. 75).
